color.note: Neutral first: white, warm stone, sand, warm near-black. One loud orange (signal) in the calm tone, lime (highlight) only in the factual tone. Semantic shadcn/ui names point to the palette; the tone decides which accent is `mark`.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Warm stone grey: quiet surfaces, form fields, choice tiles.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Stronger stone: info cards, tag frames, stone tiles.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Service tiles, mockup backgrounds. Only ink on it.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Dark stage (hero, showreel), dark in both themes.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Floating docks and the floating NavBar, with background blur and a hairline.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and the primary button on light surfaces.

tokens.name: ink-display-muted
tokens.usage: The grey second headline line. 24px and up only.

tokens.name: ink-unread
tokens.usage: Words not yet read in ScrollFillText. A passing state, never lasting text.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text over photos and on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one loud orange (calm tone): accent tiles, sparingly.

tokens.name: link-signal
tokens.usage: Orange as a text link: darker, readable.

tokens.name: signal-tint
tokens.usage: Text highlight in the calm tone.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: The yellow dot in front of subheadings.

tokens.name: go
tokens.usage: The green finish in the reading dock.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Lime surface for kickers. Factual tone only.

tokens.name: highlight-tint
tokens.usage: Text highlight in the factual tone.

tokens.name: on-media
tokens.usage: Fixed white over photos and video: the white pill.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, the 1px frame of the secondary pill on light.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: shadcn/ui: card surface, warm stone, 8px radius.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: shadcn/ui: muted areas and disabled fills.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: shadcn/ui: hover background of ghost buttons and menu rows. Neutral; the brand accent is mark.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: shadcn/ui: destructive buttons and error states.

tokens.name: destructive-text
tokens.usage: Extension: error messages. In the dark theme ink, the red line carries the colour.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: shadcn/ui: input underlines and control borders.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: shadcn/ui: focus ring, 2px with 3px offset. Ink, so it is clear on every surface.

styles.name: display-wordmark
styles.usage: One word, very large: a name as hero or above the footer. −4 %. Mobile 120px.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One statement per screen. −4 %, the second line in ink-display-muted. Mobile 56px.

styles.name: feature-title
styles.usage: Titles in FeatureStack, AudienceCard and dialogs at large size. −3 %.

styles.name: display-serif
styles.usage: The editorial accent: Cormorant Garamond in capitals. Rare: a chapter, an event, a pull quote.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Type carries the page. Images bring the colour.

styles.name: card-title
styles.sample: A practice that feels like the room
styles.usage: Titles in cards and case entries. −2.5 %.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: “The site was online two weeks later.”

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Personal support from start to finish.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons in the calm tone. Sentence case, lightly spaced.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Cormorant capitals above editorial titles and the Kicker in the calm tone.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Small sublines in mono capitals, +8 %. In the factual tone also numbers and kickers.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a pair, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inside cards, between text and image.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections. A lot of air is the style.

radius.note: Service tiles square; media tiles and docks radius-md (factual: radius-xl); floating NavBar radius-2xl; form cards radius-lg; tags radius-sm; buttons pill (factual: radius-sm).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags; mono buttons in the factual tone.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and tags in the calm tone, avatars, radios.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover on links and images: opacity, underline.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Colour changes of buttons and the navigation bar.

tokens.name: dur-reveal
tokens.usage: Content that arrives on scroll (Reveal), image zoom.

tokens.name: dur-loop
tokens.usage: Loops like the scroll hint. Never more than one loop per screen.

tokens.name: delay-2
tokens.usage: Stagger step 2: subline, second headline line.

tokens.name: dur-ring
tokens.usage: A slow rotating ring around the case thumbnail. Barely noticeable.

tokens.name: dur-scrub
tokens.usage: Smoothing for everything that follows scroll (ScrollFillText, BlurList, CardFan, FeatureStack).

tokens.name: dur-marquee
tokens.usage: One pass of the TestimonialRail. Very slow, pauses on hover.

duration.note: Short for interaction, longer for storytelling.

tokens.name: ease-entrance
tokens.usage: Everything that arrives: hero entrance, reveal, image zoom. Fast start, long settle.

tokens.name: ease-loop
tokens.usage: Back-and-forth loops (ease-in-out), e.g. the scroll hint.

easing.note: Two curves are enough: a soft brake for things that arrive, the standard ease for state changes.

tokens.name: rise-md
tokens.usage: Reveal on scroll and the content sheet sliding over the hero.

tokens.name: zoom-media
tokens.usage: Image zoom on hover in a project tile.

tokens.name: blur-near
tokens.usage: BlurList: neighbour of the active line.

tokens.name: tilt
tokens.usage: CardFan: rotation per card in the fanned stack.

tokens.name: fan-overlap
tokens.usage: CardFan: offset of cards in the stack.

distance.note: How far things move. Keep it small: motion should be felt, not watched.

shadow.note: Almost none. Surfaces are flat; only things that float get a soft shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: App or website window in a MediaFrame.

tone.note: Two tones over one theme. Set data-tone on <html> (or the page root); calm is the default. One tone per page: no pills next to mono buttons, no signal next to highlight.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: The one accent: orange (calm) or lime (factual).

tokens.name: surface-radius
tokens.usage: Media tiles, docks, cards: radius-md or radius-xl.

tokens.name: control-case
tokens.usage: Button labels: sentence case or capitals.

tokens.name: control-size
tokens.usage: Font size of button labels (mono runs wider).
